title: Octoverse: A new developer joins GitHub every second as AI leads TypeScript to #1
attributed_claim_summary: GitHub reported over 180 million developers in 2025 and TypeScript leading by its monthly contributor metric.
evidence_or_event: Source-authored report or launch; no original measurements collected in this repository.
limitations: Platform-reported descriptive numbers with evolving denominators; simultaneous AI growth is not causal attribution.
research_relevance: AI-era coding workflow -> secure functionality -> independent reuse -> lifetime cost; distinguish release availability from observed adoption.
practical_experiment: Predefine denominator and observation windows; compare verified downstream reuse against stars, commits and languages.
